testimonial.title: What it changes in practice
testimonial.subtitle: The visibility score = how many times you appear when ChatGPT and other AIs are queried across 100 searches.
testimonial.quote1: We couldn't understand why we were getting fewer new patients even though our Google reviews are excellent. The diagnostic showed that ChatGPT simply didn't know us. Within two months, we started receiving calls from patients who said they found our practice "thanks to AI".
testimonial.quote2: An American tourist told me he had asked ChatGPT "best restaurant near Eiffel Tower" and we were in the top 3 results. Before working with Eddie Miller, we didn't show up anywhere. Now we get reservations coming directly from AI.

whyUs.title: Why now is the right time
whyUs.subtitle: Every day without visibility means customers going to a competitor.
whyUs.reason1Title: The first to be visible keep the advantage
whyUs.reason1Text: AI works by habit: once it recommends a business, it keeps doing so. Getting in early means building a lasting lead.
whyUs.reason2Text: Most local businesses have no idea that ChatGPT is already influencing their customers. This is a window of opportunity that won't stay open for long.
whyUs.reason3Title: Every day without visibility means lost customers
whyUs.reason3Text: Right now, potential customers are looking for you. If AI doesn't know you, it sends them somewhere else. It's as simple as that.

verticals.title: Solutions tailored to your industry
verticals.subtitle: We work with establishments located in Paris. What needs checking depends on the business and the neighbourhood.
verticals.card1Text: Give the neighbourhood, available menu languages, last kitchen orders and the link to book a table.
verticals.card2Text: Distinguish reception hours from check-in times. Give directions from the station, languages spoken and direct booking terms.
verticals.card3Text: List the address, set times, closing time, ticketing languages and whether visitors need a booking or can walk in.
verticals.card4Text: Verify the registered specialty, address, access and appointment arrangements. Do not publish patient records or personalised medical advice.
verticals.card5Text: List contact details, phone hours and how new patients can make an appointment. No health data is needed.
verticals.card6Text: Describe practice areas and how to make first contact, in line with professional rules and without referring to client files.
verticals.card7Text: List the services, prices, Saturday hours and how to book an appointment.
verticals.card8Text: Distinguish spa admission from individual treatments. List time slots, prices and access requirements.
verticals.card9Text: Publish the timetable by activity, class levels, gym address and trial class arrangements.
verticals.card10Text: Is your business located in Paris? Tell us your neighbourhood and the service your customers look for.
verticals.card1Question: I’m visiting the Marais on Sunday. Where can I book a table for 9 pm and see the menu in English?

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: What exactly do you do for me?
faq.a1: We compare answers from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini with the details your Paris establishment publishes on its Google Business Profile and website.
faq.q2: How quickly will I see a difference?
faq.a2: For each question tested, we record the date, language, places mentioned and any sources provided.
faq.q3: Do you guarantee I'll appear on ChatGPT?
faq.a3: No. Each assistant chooses its own answer. We document mentions and errors without promising a ranking or bookings.
faq.q4: Does it really work for my industry?
faq.a4: We work with establishments located in Paris. What needs checking depends on the business and the neighbourhood.
faq.q5: I already have great Google reviews. Isn't that enough?
faq.a5: Having great Google reviews is essential, but it's only part of the equation. 83% of businesses with excellent Google reviews don't appear in ChatGPT recommendations (SOCi, 2024). AI doesn't rely on the same criteria as Google to choose who to recommend. That's exactly what we identify in the free diagnostic: what's missing for AI to recommend you too.
faq.a6: It helps, but it's not essential. A large part of your visibility comes from your Google Business Profile, industry-specific directories, and specific technical settings. We optimize your entire online presence, with or without a website.
faq.q7: How much of my time does it take?
faq.a7: Very little. You fill in a 1-minute form for the diagnostic, then we call you for 15 minutes to explain our recommendations. We guide you step by step.
faq.a8: You can. Start by comparing the address, hours and contact link on your Google Business Profile with those on your website.
faq.a9: The diagnostic is 100% free with no commitment. After that, our plans range from €399 to €1,199 depending on your needs. We explain each option during the 15-minute call.
faq.q10: What's the difference from a traditional SEO agency?
faq.a10: Alongside your Google Business Profile, we check what ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini say about your business in Paris. A dated observation is not a promise of a recommendation.
